N64 Comments // Test — RetroArch overlay
Converted by EmuSkins (https://emuskins.com/retroarch.html).

Install on iOS
  1. Move this whole folder (N64_Comments_Test) to Files > On My iPhone > RetroArch > RetroArch > overlays.
  2. In RetroArch: Settings > On-Screen Display > On-Screen Overlay > Overlay Preset > N64_Comments_Test/N64_Comments_Test.cfg.
  3. Auto-Rotate Overlay (on by default) switches landscape and portrait with the device.
     Set Overlay Opacity to 1.0 if the artwork looks faded.

Other platforms: put the folder in RetroArch's overlays directory (Settings > Directory > Overlays).

Buttons follow Mupen64Plus-Next default (Z on L2, C buttons on the right stick). On another core, remap in Quick Menu > Controls.

Layouts left out:
  - landscape (edgeToEdge): The archive has no "Landscape.pdf", so this layout cannot be drawn.

Not converted (RetroArch has nothing to bind these to):
  - touchScreenX: RetroArch cores take DS touch straight from the screen (pointer), not from an overlay button.
  - touchScreenY: RetroArch cores take DS touch straight from the screen (pointer), not from an overlay button.

Note: Thumbstick image "thumb.pdf" is not in the archive; the stick has no cap image.
Note: The alternate layouts (altRepresentations) are extra overlays; the skin's toggle button switches to them.
